title: A relaxation to the post-composition approach to metric-valued Sobolev maps
summary: We establish that the definition of Sobolev mappings from metric measure spaces to metric spaces relying on the post-composition approach of Ambrosio-Reshetnyak admits, under certain transparent assumptions on the spaces, an equivalent reformulation that is substantially weaker than the principal version. In detail, the corresponding definition requires maps of this kind to meet two successive tests in order to be called Sobolev: first a ''qualitative'' one and then a ''quantitative'' one.
